content: What is the Leader Completeness property in Raft and why does it prevent committed entries from being lost?

The Leader Completeness property ensures that if a log entry is committed in a given term, that entry will be present in the logs of the leaders for all higher-numbered terms [Raft Consensus Invariants & Safety Proofs (notes), Page 4]. This prevents committed entries from being lost because Raft's election restriction prevents a candidate from winning an election unless its log contains all committed entries. Consequently, a new leader always starts its term with all previously committed entries intact.
